+import os
+from typing import AsyncIterator, Optional
+
+from google.cloud import speech_v1 as speech
+
+
+class StreamingSpeechRecognizer:
+    def __init__(self, language_code: str = "en-US", enable_punctuation: bool = True):
+        self.client = speech.SpeechClient()
+        self.language_code = language_code
+        self.enable_punctuation = enable_punctuation
+
+    def _streaming_config(self) -> speech.StreamingRecognitionConfig:
+        config = speech.RecognitionConfig(
+            encoding=speech.RecognitionConfig.AudioEncoding.LINEAR16,
+            sample_rate_hertz=int(os.getenv("SPEECH_SAMPLE_RATE", "16000")),
+            language_code=self.language_code,
+            enable_automatic_punctuation=self.enable_punctuation,
+            model=os.getenv("GOOGLE_CLOUD_SPEECH_MODEL", "latest_long"),
+        )
+        return speech.StreamingRecognitionConfig(
+            config=config,
+            interim_results=True,
+            single_utterance=False,
+        )
+
+    def recognize(self, audio_chunks: AsyncIterator[bytes]):
+        requests = (
+            speech.StreamingRecognizeRequest(audio_content=chunk)
+            async for chunk in audio_chunks
+        )
+        return self.client.streaming_recognize(
+            config=self._streaming_config(),
+            requests=requests,
+        )
+

+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+

+@dataclass
+class PartialResult:

+    confidence: Optional[float] = None
+    segments: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None
+

+def _normalize_text(value: Any) -> str:
+    if value is None:
+        return ""
+    if isinstance(value, str):

+def _extract_segments(event: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]]:
+    segments = event.get("segments")
+    if isinstance(segments, list):
+        return segments
+    alt = event.get("alternatives")
+    if isinstance(alt, list) and alt:
+        first = alt[0]
+        if isinstance(first, dict):
+            segs = first.get("segments")

+import os
+import queue
+from typing import Generator, Optional
+
+import pyaudio
+from google.cloud import speech
+
+
+RATE = 16000
+CHUNK = int(RATE / 10)
+
+
+def _requests(audio_q: "queue.Queue[Optional[bytes]]") -> Generator[speech.StreamingRecognizeRequest, None, None]:
+    while True:
+        chunk = audio_q.get()
+        if chunk is None:
+            return
+        yield speech.StreamingRecognizeRequest(audio_content=chunk)
+
+
+def stream_microphone() -> Generator[str, None, None]:
+    client = speech.SpeechClient()
+    config = speech.RecognitionConfig(
+        encoding=speech.RecognitionConfig.AudioEncoding.LINEAR16,
+        sample_rate_hertz=RATE,
+        language_code=os.getenv("SPEECH_LANGUAGE_CODE", "en-US"),
+        enable_automatic_punctuation=True,
+        model=os.getenv("GOOGLE_CLOUD_SPEECH_MODEL", "latest_long"),
+    )
+    streaming_config = speech.StreamingRecognitionConfig(
+        config=config,
+        interim_results=True,
+        single_utterance=False,
+    )
+
+    audio_q: "queue.Queue[Optional[bytes]]" = queue.Queue()
+    pa = pyaudio.PyAudio()
+    stream = pa.open(
+        format=pyaudio.paInt16,
+        channels=1,
+        rate=RATE,
+        input=True,
+        frames_per_buffer=CHUNK,
+    )
+
+    try:
+        for _ in range(3):
+            audio_q.put(stream.read(CHUNK, exception_on_overflow=False))
+        responses = client.streaming_recognize(streaming_config, _requests(audio_q))
+        for response in responses:
+            for result in response.results:
+                if result.alternatives:
+                    yield result.alternatives[0].transcript
+    finally:
+        audio_q.put(None)
+        stream.stop_stream()
+        stream.close()
+        pa.terminate()
+
*** End Patch

+import os
+import queue
+from typing import Generator, Optional
+
+import pyaudio
+from google.cloud import speech
+
+
+RATE = 16000
+CHUNK = int(RATE / 10)
+
+
+def _requests(audio_q: "queue.Queue[Optional[bytes]]") -> Generator[speech.StreamingRecognizeRequest, None, None]:
+    while True:
+        chunk = audio_q.get()
+        if chunk is None:
+            return
+        yield speech.StreamingRecognizeRequest(audio_content=chunk)
+
+
+def stream_microphone() -> Generator[str, None, None]:
+    client = speech.SpeechClient()
+    config = speech.RecognitionConfig(
+        encoding=speech.RecognitionConfig.AudioEncoding.LINEAR16,
+        sample_rate_hertz=RATE,
+        language_code=os.getenv("SPEECH_LANGUAGE_CODE", "en-US"),
+        enable_automatic_punctuation=True,
+        model=os.getenv("GOOGLE_CLOUD_SPEECH_MODEL", "latest_long"),
+    )
+    streaming_config = speech.StreamingRecognitionConfig(
+        config=config,
+        interim_results=True,
+        single_utterance=False,
+    )
+
+    audio_q: "queue.Queue[Optional[bytes]]" = queue.Queue()
+    pa = pyaudio.PyAudio()
+    stream = pa.open(
+        format=pyaudio.paInt16,
+        channels=1,
+        rate=RATE,
+        input=True,
+        frames_per_buffer=CHUNK,
+    )
+
+    try:
+        for _ in range(3):
+            audio_q.put(stream.read(CHUNK, exception_on_overflow=False))
+        responses = client.streaming_recognize(streaming_config, _requests(audio_q))
+        for response in responses:
+            for result in response.results:
+                if result.alternatives:
+                    yield result.alternatives[0].transcript
+    finally:
+        audio_q.put(None)
+        stream.stop_stream()
+        stream.close()
+        pa.terminate()
